IITians PACE Borivali was one of the most unstable and poorly managed coaching experiences.
In just two years, the center manager changed multiple times, and at one point there was no manager at all—so students literally had no one to approach for serious issues. Teachers kept changing constantly, making it impossible to build consistency. Only a few teachers (AMSP, VKM, BYCH) stood out; the rest were highly inconsistent.
There was clear favoritism between batches. The medical batch felt neglected, while the quality of teaching in other batches was also not up to the mark. Merging JEE and NEET batches showed complete lack of planning, as both exams require very different preparation strategies.
Despite charging very high fees, the institute failed to provide even basic stability or support. The environment felt disorganized, stressful, and more like a business than an educational institution.
Interactions with non-teaching staff were often rude and unprofessional, which made the overall experience There were also incidents where the management’s behavior felt intimidating and unprofessional, which made students uncomfortable raising concerns.
Overall, this institute created more confusion than clarity and seriously affected preparation during a crucial time.
It’s better to stay home and study rather than joining such institutes they will definitely kill you dreams to achieve something in life
